categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of photovoltaic tracking support systems, fixed support systems, flexible support systems, and Building-integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) systems. It also provides intelligent operation and maintenance products such as SCADA platforms and cleaning robots for PV systems. Additionally, the company engages in EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services for solar power projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including multi-point parallel synchronous drive mechanisms, AI-based tracking control algorithms, wind engineering, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) wind tunnel testing, BIM+GIS integration, and IoT sensor networks for dual-sided PV modules. It has proprietary mechanical design software and testing systems for torque and durability. Manufacturing includes vertical integration with in-house production of key components like reducers and control boxes, and it employs customized production based on client orders.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are domestic and international power investment companies (owners) and EPC contractors involved in large-scale ground-mounted PV power stations. The company serves over 40 countries and regions globally, with significant market presence in Asia-Pacific, Europe, Latin America, Middle East, and Africa. Major end markets include utility-scale solar power plants and emerging markets with growing renewable energy demand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with six major manufacturing bases in China (Jiangsu, Anhui), India, Saudi Arabia, and Brazil. It has established three overseas regional headquarters and multiple service centers and branches worldwide, including subsidiaries in Japan, India, USA, Chile, South Africa, Spain, UAE, and Australia. Its sales and project delivery span Asia, Europe, Latin America, Middle East, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic industry supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and supply of PV mounting and tracking systems. It also extends into downstream services by providing EPC contracting and operation and maintenance solutions. The company pursues vertical integration by increasing in-house production of key components to reduce reliance on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in 'tracking+' core business and expanding into 'green power + smart energy' integrated solutions. R&D priorities include developing flexible tracking systems, intelligent AI tracking controls, wind-resistant structures, smart cleaning robots, and BIPV products. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintains a large technical team, and focuses on global certification and intellectual property protection to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of photovoltaic tracking and fixed support systems, BIPV products, and related intelligent operation and maintenance equipment. The company also earns income from EPC contracting services and power generation from its own solar power stations. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to power investors and EPC contractors, with customized system solutions tailored to client projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in the photovoltaic tracking support system segment, ranking fifth worldwide with a 9% market share in tracking systems, and is the only Chinese company in the global top five. It competes with other major international PV mounting system manufacturers and leverages its technological innovation, global supply chain, and localized overseas presence to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 9.03 billion, representing a 41.25% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 631.5 million, an 83.03% increase. Total assets reached nearly RMB 9.92 billion, growing 21.53% from the previous year. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding global market demand and increased overseas orders, with a net profit margin improvement to 7%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers differentiated value through advanced, reliable, and efficient photovoltaic tracking systems that enhance power generation efficiency and reduce operational costs. Its proprietary multi-point parallel drive technology, AI tracking algorithms, and flexible support systems adapt to complex terrains and diverse application scenarios. Comprehensive lifecycle services, global certifications, and strong intellectual property protection further distinguish its products and solutions in the competitive global PV market.
